mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) can cause nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity, while nortriptyline (tricyclic antidepressant) has anticholinergic effects that may reduce renal perfusion and increase aminoglycoside accumulation.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN) regularly; assess hearing and vestibular function; maintain adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotic if possible.
